result.changelog:
Arachnus: dropped the generic keys "armadillo creature" and "armadillo-like creature". Marukara is now given as the Japanese name. The statue smashing is credited to the retelling only. "Seen far less often" became "rarely encountered". "One of the few Chozo gifts" became "a Chozo item she had to take from a living creature"; I did not add an unverified "the only". Added the Omega Metroid Metroid II walkthrough as a source.

Deorem/Acid Worm/Kiru Giru/Imago: "recovering" her Missiles became "obtaining". The fallen Kiru Giru now plugs the hole and is gone when Samus returns. I removed the claim that the trapped larva itself grew into the Imago. Mua's lack of a Space Pirate link is now hedged. The Charge Beam drop is reworded so it follows Deorem's death wherever that happens. The Wave Beam sentence is shortened so it does not repeat the Equipment entry. The Tangle Vines claim is kept because Metroid Wiki's Kiru Giru page states it outright. Imago's attack order (ramming, then stingers as it weakened) is confirmed by Thonky's guide, which is now listed as a source. The weak point is now the stinger end of its body.

Goyagma/Vorash: replaced the "most debated choices" sentence (real-world fan reaction) with a neutral in-universe line about keeping her agreement to use only what Adam authorized. Dropped the "Pyrosphere boss/monster" keys and added plural forms of both names to keep 3+ keys. Goyagma's lava control is now hedged. Its fight is reordered to Metroid Wiki's phase order.

Hive Mecha/Incinerator Drone: dropped the "Chozo drone(s)" keys. Removed "whatever stronger weapons she carried" and "in her Chozo armor". The release caveat stays out.

All entries are 242-397 words, use no banned words and have at most 2 title tags.
result.unresolved: Whether the vine-trapped Kiru Giru and the Imago are the same individual is still unconfirmed. Only fan walkthroughs and Wikitroid snippets say so, and Wikitroid's eggs account conflicts, so the content does not say it. Metroid Wiki has no Imago page; Imago details come from two fan guides (Omega Metroid, Thonky). Goyagma and Vorash have only 4 keys, two of them plurals I added to reach the minimum, because no verified alternate names exist. "Charge Beam Beast" is still used only as a key, with no official source.
